_readme: verify-context-coverage detection vocabulary + frozen references (context-defaults-economy task 1.4, design.md '门禁合同 — verify:context'). Versioned v1: the vocabulary is an EXACT enumeration (no wildcards) — extending it is a version bump, never an edit in place. frozenAvailability mirrors the variant grammar's frozen table (openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-27-variant-grammar/design.md §4, authoritative) — the gate asserts bidirectional equality (values ≡ table row) against this mirror, so a table change there must land here in the same change. The 2.1 pilot additions extend the mirror for the two proxy families whose paint slots restate a frozen row's domain rather than mint one: button-group (the zone's four-value domain — a structural provider family, own = the silent rung its children fall to) and icon-button (press-button's whole five-value ladder restated verbatim, the X2-11 restate decision; the grammar itself rules 'IconButton forwards the new union, not a separate color decision'). slot-values-first (2026-09-04): slotFactories is the values-first factory vocabulary — generic:true marks the two explicit-type-argument faces (absentSlot, defineOpenSlot) with no values tuple to infer from; definePaintSlot's first argument (the inline values tuple) IS the family union's source, and paintVariantUnion is asserted against that tuple — the same-folder-union extraction ceiling is retired. Domain notes (reconcile r2, 2026-09-04): the physics texture axis is OUTSIDE this economy by ruling — press-button's `raised` resolves `explicit ?? zone ?? true` over PRESS_TEXTURE_KEY (its own zone key, written by ButtonVariantScope), never a Defaults slot, because physics flows through joined groups while paint does not; it is not a vocabulary word and carries no exemptions entry. Single-file non-item components under registry/files/ui/ root (search-palette.svelte, a site composition) are out of gate reach — zero props today; registering them or moving them into a family folder is the remedy if they ever grow a style vocabulary. pilotFamilies below serves manual --scope=pilot runs only; the gate itself scans every registry:ui family. Amendment 2026-09-05 (dfe91725, Owner frameless ruling): icon-button's variant own is ghost — the glyph IS the content, a frame is chrome noise; X2-11 amended and defaults-buttons.spec pins the contract. Amendment 2026-09-07 (markdown-coverage): blockquote joins the frozen table as the reading-content quote surface, alert's row shape verbatim (outline/tonal, own outline) — quote readability excludes fill AND ghost (ghost is interactive-chrome vocabulary, which a static quote misuses); the borderless manuscript indent stays a future structural axis, never a paint rung. Amendment 2026-09-08 (button-bar): the free-floating action lane joins as a proxy family in button-group's shape (the zone's four-value domain) with own ghost — the lane's load-bearing identity (members fall to the quietest chrome rung by default); fused is excluded from the zone domain, the button families carry no fused rung. Retraction 2026-09-09 (card-surface-kernel): the button-bar row is RETIRED with the component (the structural kernel law — loose rows are utilities, zone belongs to the bands); the row is removed in the same change that deleted the family. Vocabulary v2 (2026-09-19, the Context round): 'theme' joins the detection set — the shell-vocabulary families (terminal-header/terminal-card literal dark|light|system, mermaid literal auto|light|dark, code-card open string) now ship Defaults contracts (context round 2) and the gate enforces them; pattern-hero-set rides a passthrough exemption (forwards verbatim to TerminalCard's contract), prototype-kit rides no-style (frame-view: the theme attribute is the FRAMED document's environment channel, stamped into the iframe — not frame-view's own style) + passthrough (prototype-component forwards to frame-view). The vocabulary stays an EXACT enumeration — v3 needs the same bump discipline. Amendment 2026-09-21 (explicit-props W1 1.7, design §11): axisContextKeys joins the eight-axis supply set — the universal context keys jx.size · jx.shape · jx.radius · jx.density · jx.color · jx.theme · jx.elevation · jx.motion are pinned by their IDENTIFIER constants in the kernel lib (defaults.svelte.ts: SIZE_KEY, SHAPE_KEY, RADIUS_KEY, UNIVERSAL_DENSITY_KEY, COLOR_KEY, THEME_KEY, ELEVATION_KEY, MOTION_KEY), so a family bypassing the universal slot seam with a direct getContext(<key const>) is an A3 finding exactly like the legacy channels; the detection vocabulary (the style-prop word list) is UNTOUCHED, so the version stays 2 per the bump discipline (version tracks the vocabulary array, the file's own precedent). Amendment 2026-09-21 (explicit-props W3 batch A): slotFactories gains the eight universal axis-slot factories (sizeAxisSlot/shapeAxisSlot/radiusAxisSlot/densityAxisSlot/colorAxisSlot/themeAxisSlot/elevationAxisSlot/motionAxisSlot — defaults.svelte.ts's DefaultsSlot products for the §9.1 lanes, 0–1 args = the optional own): a family Defaults contract now covers its vocabulary-hit universal props (size/shape/radius/density/theme/elevation) with REAL slots — the registered-factory set extends by the same amendment discipline the axisContextKeys round used; the vocabulary array is untouched, version stays 2.
